But we can approximate using fuel range. Fuel range 560 km. Car consumption 8.2 L/100km. So fuel in tank = (560 km * 8.2 L/100km)/100 = 560*0.082 = 45.92 L. Convert to gallons: 45.92 / 3.785 = 12.13 gallons. So tank capacity 50 gallons, so remaining 37.87 gallons. So we need to add 37.87 gallons. Let's round to 37.9 gallons. Use fillFuelTank with 37.9. Then convert to liters. Use gallon_to_liter.
